scope: Local SQL014 task.createOneOff commandReceipt permission matrix, read-only state, and company membership revocation

vitest.command: node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run tests/m2-2c-contract.test.ts -t "one-off commandReceipt role" --maxWorkers=1 --testTimeout=30000 --hookTimeout=30000
vitest.matrix: boss and manager own-receipt allow; same-organization other actor and other-organization privacy return found:false; owner/actor inactive, manager inactive, and manager_id NULL deny with 42501; full business/fence/head/audit/receipt snapshot is unchanged across reads; synthetic exact-shape receipt denies with 42501 when team_members is absent, with a stable read-only snapshot

scenario.name: M2.2C one-off commandReceipt serializes read-first RC and aborts stale revoke-first RR
scenario.readFirstRC: query returns 00000; pg_blocking_pids confirms revocation waits; revocation commits; subsequent query returns 42501
scenario.revokeFirstRR: revocation returns 00000; stale snapshot query returns 40001; fresh retry returns 42501

permissionMatrix.readOnlySnapshot: creation heads, month/membership/operation fences, audit rows, and receipts unchanged
permissionMatrix.missingTeamMember: 42501 against a synthetic exact-shape commandReceipt inserted once for an employee with no assignments; arguments/result are not modified, no assignment or constraint is disabled

behavior.authorization: Revalidates current actor/owner relationship, company membership, and team membership before returning the exact immutable receipt.
behavior.locking: Read-only coordination plan includes actor/owner profile and month locks plus membership:<company>:<owner>; no fence writes on query.
behavior.preserved: Exact receipt response when authorized; current membership revocation denies; no business rows or receipt mutation. Synthetic absent-team case exercises the same SQL authorization guard but is not a command_v1-emitted receipt.

limitations: Synthetic local fixtures only; not applied to Supabase.

A command_v1-emitted receipt cannot coexist with absent team_members while its task assignment is live: assignment_team_member requires membership, and immutable task-responsibility rows also bind the assignment's task instance. The team guard is covered using a structurally exact synthetic receipt for a no-assignment employee, with arguments/result kept unchanged and a stable no-write snapshot. This verifies the query denial branch but does not claim an application-generated receipt in an unreachable live-assignment state.
Covers task.createOneOff commandReceipt only; does not close M2.2C/Gate L or other receipt families.
No hosted Supabase Auth/HTTP behavior is tested.
